External Dependencies

The external module is a utility module that hosts third-party libraries locally. This ensures that the Hams.com platform remains fully functional even without access to the global internet.

Leaflet.js

Used for rendering maps in the World Map and Operator Directory. We host version 1.9.4.

Transformers.js

Used for Edge AI processing, such as recognizing callsigns in speech. "Edge" means the model runs in your own browser rather than on the server. We host version 2.16.1.

Other Hosted Libraries

The module also hosts D3.js 7.9.0 with d3-geo-projection 4.0.0 and topojson-client 3.1.0 (map rendering), the @noble cryptography libraries 2.3.0, and ft8js, a WebAssembly build of an FT8 decoder and encoder. The module's README lists each library's license and how its files were built.

Security & Privacy

By hosting these files locally, we prevent third-party CDNs (Content Delivery Networks) from tracking our users' IP addresses and usage patterns.
